# Economy: REST API Reference

5 REST endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Funding Conditions

### Funding Conditions

`GET /fed/v1/funding-conditions` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/economy/funding-conditions.md)

Daily U.S. overnight funding snapshot — one row per day showing how cheap or tight it is for banks and dealers to borrow cash overnight.

- **Params:** `date` (.gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `date effective_fed_funds_rate effective_fed_funds_volume fed_funds_target_lower fed_funds_target_upper fed_overnight_repo_treasury_amount fed_overnight_reverse_repo_treasury_amount financial_commercial_paper_90d_rate interest_on_reserve_balances nonfinancial_commercial_paper_90d_rate obfr_25th_percentile obfr_75th_percentile obfr_volume overnight_bank_funding_rate secured_overnight_financing_rate sofr_25th_percentile sofr_75th_percentile sofr_volume tgcr_25th_percentile tgcr_75th_percentile tri_party_general_collateral_rate tri_party_general_collateral_volume` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** any plan, any asset class · recency Updated daily · history Records date back to July 1, 1954

## Inflation

### Inflation

`GET /fed/v1/inflation` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/economy/inflation.md)

Retrieve key indicators of realized inflation, reflecting actual changes in consumer prices and spending behavior in the U.S. economy.

- **Params:** `date` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `cpi cpi_core cpi_year_over_year date pce pce_core pce_spending` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** any plan, any asset class · recency Updated monthly · history Records date back to January 1, 1947

## Inflation Expectations

### Inflation Expectations

`GET /fed/v1/inflation-expectations` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/economy/inflation-expectations.md)

Retrieve a broad view of how inflation is expected to evolve over time in the U.S. economy.

- **Params:** `date` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `date forward_years_5_to_10 market_10_year market_5_year model_10_year model_1_year model_30_year model_5_year` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** any plan, any asset class · recency Updated monthly · history Records date back to January 1, 1982

## Labor Market

### Labor Market

`GET /fed/v1/labor-market` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/economy/labor-market.md)

Retrieve key labor market indicators from the Federal Reserve, including unemployment rate, labor force participation, average hourly earnings, and job openings data.

- **Params:** `date` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `avg_hourly_earnings date job_openings labor_force_participation_rate unemployment_rate` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** any plan, any asset class · recency Updated monthly · history Records date back to January 1, 1948

## Treasury Yields

### Treasury Yields

`GET /fed/v1/treasury-yields` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/economy/treasury-yields.md)

Retrieve historical U.S. Treasury yield data for standard timeframes ranging from 1-month to 30-years, with daily historical records back to 1962.

- **Params:** `date` (.any_of .gt .gte .lt .lte), `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `date yield_10_year yield_1_month yield_1_year yield_20_year yield_2_year yield_30_year yield_3_month yield_3_year yield_5_year yield_6_month yield_7_year` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** any plan, any asset class · recency Updated daily · history Records date back to January 2, 1962
